diffs.diff: position_voltage_V: datasheet reading gives 0.000805861 per count, the part's model has 1
diffs.evidence: The model reports raw 12-bit ADC counts (scale 1, 0-4095) while the second reading converted counts to volts with an assumed 3.3 V reference (3.3/4095 = 0.000805861 V/count), exactly the conversion in the Pimoroni IO Expander library 'return (reading / 4095.0) * self._vref' whose default vref is 3.3; the reading is ratiometric to the 3-5 V supply, so counts are the equivalent, supply-independent unit.
